description: PlanIn BI Versioning is a powerful Power BI custom visual designed to streamline the creation and management of planning and forecasting versions directly within Power BI. This table visual empowers users to initialize new plans or duplicate existing ones, providing flexibility and control in managing planning cycles and forecasting scenarios. With PlanIn BI Versioning, users can easily create plans for future periods, such as the upcoming year or beyond. During initialization, users can select the base data for the new plan, choosing from options like actual data from the previous year, existing plans, or a mixed approach where some months are based on actuals while others rely on forecasts or prior plans. This enables organizations to tailor their planning processes to their specific needs, ensuring accuracy and relevance. Users can also duplicate existing plans to create multiple variations, allowing for scenario-based forecasting and comparison.The visual includes robust status management capabilities, allowing users to track and update the lifecycle of plans and versions. Fully supported in Power BI Service, PlanIn BI Versioning does not function on Power BI Desktop. This visual requires additional purchases and specific licensing, along with the PlanIn BI - Data Refresh Service (available on AppSource) for real-time data updates.
